# Kinetic Construct (kinetic-serif v1.2.3)
> A high-density editorial design system with tactile chrome, Warm Alabaster surfaces, and Botanical Field semantic accents.

## Core Documentation
- [Design System Guide](reference/guide.md): Editorial before ornamental, 3-role semantic rules, and spatial ergonomics.
- [Design Tokens (JSON)](reference/kinetic-serif.json): Machine-readable CSS tokens, colors, typography scales, and chrome specifications.
- [AI Companion Skill](reference/SKILL.md): Standard system prompt instructions for generating compliant architecture explainers.
- [Architecture Specimen](reference/architecture-spec.md): GCP Terraform specimen with four architectural laws. The supplied Conceptual Model enumeration is missing.
- [Full LLM Bundle](llms-full.txt): Consolidated guide, agent instructions, tokens, stylesheet, runtime, starter, and architecture fragment.

## Quick CDN Links
- [Stylesheet](css/kinetic-serif.css)
- [Runtime JS](js/kinetic-serif.js)
- [Starter Boilerplate](starter/index.html)

Resolve these links relative to this manifest's URL, including the repository path on GitHub Pages.
